div.span:
1. Regulation and enterprise policy want an inventory of what is running in production. Feature branches are not production.
2. Day-0 response (think Log4Shell): security teams query production SBOMs to ask “which deployed apps ship the vulnerable library?”
Only main images are ever pushed, so the main SBOMs are the official production inventory.
